name: John F. Kennedy
desc: president of the United States from 1961 to 1963 (1917–1963)
birthplace: John Fitzgerald Kennedy National Historic Site
summary: John Fitzgerald Kennedy (May 29, 1917 – November 22, 1963), also known as JFK, was the 35th president of the United States, serving from 1961 until his assassination in 1963. A member of the Democratic Party, he represented Massachusetts in both houses of the U.S. Congress before his presidency. Kennedy was the youngest elected president at 43 years, and the first Roman Catholic president.
